descripcion:
Ross Stores CEO pay ratio: $16.99 million for the CEO, $9,602 for the median employee, both for fiscal 2024. From the archive: Apr 2025. Not today's news.

What is a CEO pay ratio? Public companies report in their proxy statement (the yearly document sent to shareholders) what the CEO was paid next to what the median employee, the one in the exact middle of the pay line, was paid. Ross Stores's proxy, dated Apr 8, 2025, says: "Maintaining management stability and retaining smart people who know our business are critical to our success." In the same document, it reports its CEO's annual total compensation for fiscal 2024 was $16,994,251 and for the median employee was $9,602. Per the proxy, the median employee is a part-time hourly store associate.

The math: $16,994,251 ÷ $9,602 = about 1,770. That is roughly 1,770 median-worker salaries in one year of CEO pay. The proxy states the ratio as 1,770 to 1. These are fiscal 2024 pay figures, as the proxy reports them.

Smart people are critical. Here is the median worker's pay. (Our take.)
